rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a hatching blastocyst and identifies ICM, TE, and zona thinning appropriately. Minor overstatement of certainty from a single image and limited discussion of image quality/pre-collapse features prevent a perfect score.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, sperm parameters, prior losses, and unexplained infertility with embryo quality well. Slightly overstates favorable factors and does not fully nuance how prior miscarriage/biochemical history modifies prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimate tied to age and morphology. Some claims are too strong, such as calling 4AA the gold standard and implying high likelihood of euploidy from morphology alone.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice regarding morphology and transfer planning, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as thrombophilia/immune workup framing and overemphasis on morphology as a predictor of euploidy/implantation.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, monitoring, and future-cycle considerations. Recommendations are useful, though some are somewhat generic and could be more individualized regarding recurrent pregnancy loss evaluation thresholds.
